{"action":"draft","body":"Subject: Draft — Seattle team staffing update (Effective Oct 31)  
To: Seattle team distribution (to be confirmed)  

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED — DO NOT SEND

Team,

This is a draft announcement regarding staffing changes in our Seattle organization. Please do not forward; Legal must review and approve this message before distribution.

Summary
- Roles affected: 14
- Effective date: October 31

Next steps
- Managers will begin private one-on-one conversations starting tomorrow morning to notify impacted individuals and discuss immediate next steps.
- HR will provide details about severance, benefits, and transition support on Monday. We will share those specifics as soon as HR confirms.

We are committed to supporting everyone through this transition and will provide as much information and help as possible. If you have immediate questions, please contact your manager or HR (HR contact TBD).

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]

Note to legal: please review and advise any required edits or additional language prior to distribution."}
